note: Both arms read the repositories at one path -- the MCP arm's git server reads the image's own /data/repos in the run's container, and each mirage /data/repos mount is a copy of one taken out of the same image; no tool this task enables reads the rest of /data. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing. Slack is the fake both arms read, seeded per run from Atlas's export. Airtable is the fake both arms read, seeded per run with the base Atlas shares in place of an export.
